description: This source file implements utility functions for device resources, including formatting resource details, obtaining resource values, reading input lines, tokenizing input strings, and representing resource modes as strings. It is part of a device management SDK, with functions referencing resource-related structures and string utilities.

methods.name: char * getResourceDump(const DSResource * resource)
methods.description: Creates a human-readable string that summarizes the details of a given device resource, including its id, uri, owner, type, mode, and value.

methods.name: char * getResourceValue(const DSResource * resource)
methods.description: Returns the resource's value unless it is marked as sensitive, in which case it returns a placeholder string indicating encryption.

methods.name: char * getInputLine()
methods.description: Reads a line of input from standard input, handling dynamic buffer resizing, and returns the input line as a string. Returns 'exit' if EOF is encountered.

methods.name: char ** getTokenizedInput(const char * line,int * numTokens)
methods.description: Splits an input line into tokens, handling quoted strings as single tokens, and returns an array of tokens with the number of tokens output through an argument.

methods.name: const char * stringifyMode(uint8_t mode)
methods.description: Converts a resource mode bitmask into a human-readable string representation of permissions and flags.

methods.name: char ** saveToken(char ** args,int numArgs,const char * start,const char * end)

ctags.name: saveToken
ctags.pattern: /^static char **saveToken(char **args, int numArgs, const char *start, const char *end)$/
ctags.signature: (char ** args,int numArgs,const char * start,const char * end)
